boundary.description: From the point where M61 Motorway crosses Worsley Road North, E along the M61 Motorway and then N along M60 Motorway to junction 13 and Bridgewater way. Then W along Bridgewater Way and by a straight line N crossing East Lancashire Road, through Ellerbeck Crescent to the footpath (Tyldesley Loopline) to the point where it meets Leigh Guided Busway and by a beeline to Ellenbrook Loopline along the path and then by a beeline crossing Hilton Lane, and highstreet and going between Athens Drive and Kinsley Drive. N to and along Campbell Way and E by N border of Tesco Store to and N along Bolton Road and Worsley Road North to the point where it corsses M61 Motorway.
